name: Diffity Diff
summary: Open the diffity diff viewer in the browser to see your changes

name: Diffity Learn
summary: Start a project-driven learning journey for any technical topic — programming languages, tools, frameworks, or concepts. Teaches through real projects, Diffity tours, and interactive conversation, adapting to the learner's pace.

name: Diffity Resolve
summary: Read open review comments and resolve them by making code fixes

name: Diffity Resolve Tree
summary: Read open comments from the tree browser and resolve them by making code fixes

name: Diffity Review
summary: Review current diff and leave comments using diffity agent commands

name: Diffity Tour
summary: Create a guided code tour that walks through the codebase to answer a question or explain a feature. Opens in the browser with step-by-step navigation and highlighted code.

name: Diffity Tree
summary: Open the diffity file tree browser to browse and comment on repository files

name: Page Mascot
summary: Put a cursor-tracking mascot on a page -- a chibi character that turns its head toward the pointer and reacts when clicked. Picks one of the fifty-two drawn characters and wires up the React component, or draws a new one (with your own image tool, the OpenAI images API, or from a photo of the user), builds its two sprite sheets into aligned atlases and verifies they do not jump. Use when the user asks for a mascot, a character that watches the cursor, a portfolio head, wants one of the existing characters on their page, or wants a new character drawn.
